title: The Solo Four Mystery {4, 6, 8, 12}
hook: Across the entire infinite universe of even integers, only FOUR numbers possess exactly ONE prime pair decomposition. Why does every other even number have two or more?

title: The Parity Arithmetic Sandbox (Odd + Odd = Even)
hook: Why does Goldbach's Conjecture ask only about EVEN numbers? Explore visual 2-row tiles to understand why primes (except 2) must always fuse into perfectly paired even rectangles!

title: Binary Prime Partition Trees
hook: Students know prime factor trees (multiplication), but what does an ADDITIVE Goldbach tree look like? Explore how even numbers branch into pairs of prime leaves!

title: Dynamic Eratosthenes Sieve & Prime Complement Radar
hook: Watch the ancient Sieve of Eratosthenes sift composite numbers in real time, then fire the Complement Radar beam to detect when prime reflections $N - p$ are also prime!

title: Twin Prime Bridges & Midpoints
hook: Twin primes $(p, p+2)$ have an even midpoint $m$. Discover why every twin prime pair naturally builds an indestructible suspension bridge proving Goldbach for $2m$!

title: Cousin & Sexy Prime Constellations
hook: Beyond twin primes ($d=2$) lie cousin primes ($d=4$) and "sexy" primes ($d=6$, from Latin sex). Look up at the number-theory night sky to see these prime constellations generate Goldbach sums!

title: The Goldbach Step-Staircase
hook: Climb an ascending staircase where each step is an even integer and stacked blocks represent its Goldbach pairs. Watch how skyscrapers rise on multiples of 6 while valleys dip on powers of 2!

title: Circular Chord String Art
hook: Wrap primes around a circle and connect Goldbach pairs with luminous string chords. Discover the mesmerizing cardioids, envelopes, and geometric harp strings of prime addition!

title: Goldbach Dominoes
hook: Can you fit exactly TWO prime dominoes into the target strip? Click prime dominoes to snap them into the frame and discover all possible solutions for each level!

title: The Prime Bead Abacus
hook: Slide authentic prime beads along dual brass wires to reach exact numerical equilibrium. When the top bead $p$ and bottom bead $q$ sum to target $N$, the abacus glows with balanced energy!

title: The 6k ± 1 Gear Mechanism
hook: Why do all prime numbers greater than 3 live exclusively on just TWO numbers: $6k-1$ and $6k+1$? Turn the 6-toothed mechanical gear to see four of the six teeth completely blocked by 2 and 3!

title: The Multiple-of-6 Prime Bonus Lab
hook: Compare three consecutive even numbers: $6k-2$, $6k$, and $6k+2$. Why does the multiple of 6 ALWAYS get approximately twice as many Goldbach pairs as its neighbors?

title: The Primorial Oasis ($N \pmod{30}$)
hook: The primorial $30 = 2 \times 3 \times 5$ acts as an ultra-rich oasis in number theory. Spin the concentric mod-30 wheel to see how divisibility by 2, 3, and 5 produces an astonishing 2.67× pair boost!

title: The Forbidden Residues Inspector
hook: Why can't primes land on just any remainder? Inspect modular lockouts across moduli $m = 3, 5, 7, 11$ and see which residue channels are strictly forbidden from producing Goldbach pairs!

title: Modular Kaleidoscope
hook: Turn the modular dial ($m = 6, 12, 24, 30, 60$) to transform raw prime pairs into luminous geometric mandalas and discover radial symmetry hidden in Goldbach sums!

title: Fermat's Sum of Two Squares vs. Goldbach
hook: Pierre de Fermat proved which primes are the sum of two squares ($a^2 + b^2 = p$). How does his solved theorem compare to Goldbach's unsolved sum of two primes ($p + q = N$)?

title: Goldbach Billiard Table
hook: Shoot a billiard ball around a 6-cushion hexagonal table. Can your shot bounce between Prime Pockets (1 and 5) to score a verified Goldbach combination for target $N$?

title: Residue Roulette Wheel
hook: Spin the probabilistic prime roulette wheel! When a random prime $p$ is selected, what are the odds that its partner $N - p$ also hits a prime slot? Test the probabilistic heart of Goldbach's conjecture!

title: The 2·3·7 = 42 Cross-Sieve
hook: Famous in pop culture as the "Answer to the Ultimate Question," $42 = 2 \times 3 \times 7$ holds a profound secret in number theory: how divisibility by 7 creates an extra 1.20× resonance layer in the Goldbach comet!

title: Two Hands of the Modulo Clock
hook: Rotate the dual hands of a mathematical clock ($m = 12$) to solve linear congruences $p + q \equiv N \pmod m$. When both hands point to primes summing to $N$, the clock bell chimes in harmonic resonance!

title: The Prime Grid Lattice ($p, q$ Coordinate Plane)
hook: Plot every pair of primes $(p, q)$ as points of light in a 2D coordinate plane. Watch the diagonal line $x + y = N$ slice through the starfield, illuminating Goldbach solutions at every intersection!

title: Paper-Folding Symmetry along $N/2$
hook: Imagine the number line printed on a paper tape from 0 to $N$. Fold the tape in half along the midpoint crease $N/2$. Wherever two prime dots press against each other, a Goldbach pair is born!

title: The Goldbach Step Pyramid
hook: Stack 3D isometric blocks for every Goldbach pair to construct an architectural monument! Layer $N=4$ crowns the pyramid tip; as numbers descend, layers widen into an unshakeable bedrock!

title: Ulam Spiral Pair Highlighter
hook: Stanislaw Ulam's famous spiral arranges integers in a counter-clockwise vortex. Watch diagonal prime constellations connect through glowing Goldbach bridges for any chosen even number $N$!

title: Regular Polygons with Prime Vertices
hook: Inscribe a regular $N$-gon inside a circle with numbered vertices. Why do Goldbach prime chords always form a family of parallel geometric rungs spanning across the polygon?

title: Prime Right Triangles & Areas
hook: Build right-angled triangles whose legs are prime numbers $p$ and $q$ summing to $N$. Which prime pair encloses the largest possible area, and which stretches into an ultra-sharp needle?

title: Prime Wave Superposition
hook: Send two wave pulses through a medium from opposite ends ($0$ and $N$). Where prime wavepackets collide, constructive interference produces glowing double-height crests: the Goldbach resonances!

title: Voronoi Diagram of Goldbach Complements
hook: Partition continuous mathematical space into Voronoi cells seeded by prime pairs $(p, N-p)$. Discover how dense prime attraction basins eliminate any "void zones" near the center!

title: Hexagonal Honeycomb Goldbach Explorer
hook: A bee's honeycomb has 6 natural directions. In modular arithmetic, hexagons provide the perfect geometric coordinate system for $6k \pm 1$ prime pairs!

title: Poincaré Disk Prime Bridge
hook: Step into the non-Euclidean realm of hyperbolic geometry! Map primes to the infinite boundary of the Poincaré disk, where Goldbach pairs weave through space as hyperbolic geodesics!

title: Infinite Zoom Goldbach Comet
hook: Behold the celestial signature of Goldbach's Conjecture: the Goldbach Comet! Pan and zoom through thousands of even integers to see the multi-band parabolic rays formed by modular arithmetic.

title: The Desert of Powers of 2 ($2^k$)
hook: Powers of 2 ($16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512...$) are the arid deserts of number theory. Why do they form the strict bottom floor of the Goldbach comet?

title: The Oasis Peaks of Primorials ($2, 6, 30, 210, 2310$)
hook: If powers of 2 are the desert floor, primorials are Everest! Explore how products of the first $k$ primes achieve the absolute maximum Goldbach richness in the universe.

title: The Hardy-Littlewood Conjecture Calculator
hook: In 1923, G. H. Hardy and J. E. Littlewood predicted the exact frequency of Goldbach pairs using the Circle Method. Test their formula against empirical reality for any even integer!

title: The Twin Prime Constant $C_2 \approx 0.66016$
hook: A single magic number links Twin Primes to Goldbach's Conjecture: the Twin Prime Constant $C_2$. Watch an infinite product of prime fractions converge to the universal bedrock of the Goldbach comet!

title: Comet Density & Ratio Distribution
hook: Normalize the Goldbach comet by dividing out $N / \ln^2 N$. The resulting histogram reveals three distinct Gaussian peaks corresponding to modular resonances!

title: Smallest Prime Hunter $p_{\min}(N)$
hook: What is the very first prime $p$ that successfully unlocks a Goldbach pair for $N$? Hunt down $p_{\min}(N)$ and discover why even massive numbers are unlocked by surprisingly tiny primes!

title: The Champion Integers Hall of Fame
hook: Meet the record-breaking "Champion Integers" that set brand-new all-time highs for the smallest Goldbach prime $p_{\min}(N)$! Step through mathematical history to see who pushed the boundary furthest.

title: Audio-Visual Fourier Spectrogram
hook: Listen to the hidden music of the Goldbach Comet! Decompose the sequence of Goldbach pairs into Fourier frequencies to hear the resounding harmonic peaks of 3, 5, and 7.

title: Logarithmic Upper & Lower Envelope Bounds
hook: Between what two mathematical curves is the Goldbach Comet trapped? Discover the logarithmic envelope corridor that guarantees the comet never drops to zero or flies away to infinity!

title: Ternary Goldbach Scale ($p_1 + p_2 + p_3$)
hook: The "Weak" Goldbach Conjecture states that every odd number $> 5$ is the sum of THREE primes. Fully PROVEN by Harald Helfgott in 2013! Balance the triple-pan prime scale to verify it yourself.

title: The 271-Year Journey: Euler to Helfgott
hook: From a handwritten letter in 1742 to a monumental 2013 mathematical proof: explore the 271-year epic quest that finally conquered the Weak Goldbach Conjecture!

title: The Circle Method (Major & Minor Arcs)
hook: The Hardy-Littlewood Circle Method is the most powerful weapon in additive number theory. See how prime vectors resonate into massive beams on "Major Arcs" and cancel into dust on "Minor Arcs"!

title: 3D Triangular Simplex of Prime Triples
hook: In 3D space, $x + y + z = \text{Odd}$ carves out an equilateral triangular plane. Rotate the 3D coordinate simplex to see prime triples $(p_1, p_2, p_3)$ scatter like glowing stars across the triangle!

title: Reducing Ternary to Binary ($\text{Odd} - 3 = \text{Even}$)
hook: Why does solving the Strong (Even) Goldbach Conjecture automatically prove the Weak (Odd) one? Subtract a single block of 3 to watch the ternary problem reduce seamlessly to binary!

title: The 3-Prime Harmonic Chords
hook: In music, three notes make a harmonic triad chord. Play the musical acoustic chords produced by 3-prime Goldbach partitions and hear harmony in pure prime ratios!

title: Smallest Primes in Ternary Partitions
hook: In binary Goldbach, the smallest prime can be as high as 19 or 73. But in ternary partitions, can EVERY odd number $\ge 9$ be unlocked by the tiny prime 3? Test the "Universal 3" phenomenon!

title: Ramanujan Partitions $p(n)$ vs. Goldbach
hook: Srinivasa Ramanujan unlocked unrestricted integer partitions $p(n)$, which explode exponentially ($p(100) = 190,569,292$). How does his combinatorial forest compare to the delicate prime stream of Goldbach?

title: Vinogradov's Astronomical Bound
hook: How did mathematicians crush a bound from $10^{6,800,000}$ down to $10^{27}$ and finally to ZERO? Step through the 76-year exponential plummet that solved the Weak Goldbach Conjecture!

title: Ternary Prime Dominoes
hook: Fit exactly THREE prime dominoes into an odd target strip! Pick 3 prime lengths to seamlessly cover the interval with no gaps and celebrate Helfgott's proven theorem!

title: Goldbach Concentration (Memory Match)
hook: Flip the mystery prime cards and pair two numbers that sum exactly to the target even number N! Test your spatial memory and mental arithmetic in this classic card puzzle.

title: Speed Math: Goldbach Blitz Duel
hook: Race against the countdown clock! Given target even N and prime $p$, instantly deduce the missing partner prime $q = N - p$. Chain streaks together for massive combo multipliers!

title: Escape the Composite Maze
hook: Navigate the dangerous dungeon! You carry a Prime Key. You can only step into an adjacent chamber if the chamber's number is a Prime, and their sum equals an even Goldbach milestone!

title: Goldbach Mini-Sudoku
hook: Fill the 4×4 grid exclusively with Prime Numbers {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} so that every 2×1 block or row pair sums to the designated Goldbach even target!

title: Prime Cross-Number Puzzle
hook: Crosswords meet Goldbach! Enter numbers into the grid where every Across and Down clue is deduced from prime pairs, modular complements, and Goldbach partitions.

title: Case of the Oasis Heist
hook: The elusive "Primorial Phantom" has burgled three major vaults! The detective bureau discovered a secret pattern: the thief only strikes vaults whose combination number possesses an extreme Goldbach Richness Score. Deduce their next target!

title: Desert Island Survival Math
hook: Stranded in the harsh math desert! Each day, your expedition requires an exact calorie quota $N$. Craft your daily ration by combining exactly TWO Prime Supplies to survive the 5-day trek.

title: The Goldbach Secret Code Cipher
hook: Can prime number theory encrypt secret messages? In this cryptographic cipher, each letter is encrypted as an Even Target & Prime Pair $(N, p)$. Decryption succeeds only if both $p$ and $N - p$ satisfy Goldbach primality!

title: Who Wants to Be a Number Theorist?
hook: Climb the 10-question mathematical ladder from $100 up to the grand $1,000,000 Goldbach Prize! Use your three historical lifelines when the questions get rigorous.

title: Boss Battle: The Goldbach Dragon
hook: The mighty Dragon Ignis protects the ancient treasure vault with mystical even armor! To penetrate each armor shield, cast two Prime Magic Stones that sum exactly to the Dragon's Armor HP!

title: Prime Polynomial Squaring $(P(x)^2)$
hook: Square the generating polynomial of primes: $P(x) = x^2 + x^3 + x^5 + x^7 + \dots$ The coefficient of $x^N$ in $P(x)^2$ is precisely the number of Goldbach representations of $N$!

title: FFT Prime Convolution Visualizer
hook: How did supercomputers verify Goldbach up to $4 \times 10^{18}$? They didn't test pairs one-by-one! They used the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to multiply prime polynomials in $O(N \log N)$ instead of $O(N^2)$ time!

title: Cramér's Random Model for Goldbach
hook: If primes were generated by rolling weighted dice with probability $1/\ln x$, what is the chance that any even number has zero Goldbach pairs? Explore Harald Cramér's probabilistic model and the Borel-Cantelli lemma.

title: Monte Carlo Prime Darts
hook: Throw thousands of random prime coordinate darts $(p_1, p_2)$ onto a 2D integer square $[0, N]^2$. Measure how often random prime pairs collide onto the Goldbach diagonal $x + y = N$!

title: The Complete Goldbach Matrix
hook: Explore the prime addition table $M_{i, j} = p_i + p_j$. Hover across the matrix to inspect anti-diagonal level sets where distinct prime pairs converge to the exact same even sum!

title: The Prime Coin Change Machine
hook: A vending machine stocked exclusively with Prime Coins: {2¢, 3¢, 5¢, 7¢, 11¢, 13¢, 17¢...}. Can every even price be paid with exactly two coins? What happens if you request an odd price?

title: Normal Distribution of Prime Partner Sums
hook: Add every prime under $M$ to every other prime under $M$. What shape does the resulting frequency histogram take? Discover how the Central Limit Theorem creates a bell-shaped Gaussian envelope over Goldbach sums!

title: Divisor Functions & Prime Pair Bounds
hook: How do modern sieves prove upper bounds on Goldbach pairs? Explore the Dirichlet hyperbola method and see how the divisor function $d(N)$ and Selberg's sieve construct an impenetrable ceiling over $g(N)$!

title: Polignac's Conjecture vs. Goldbach
hook: Are prime sums and prime differences two sides of the same coin? Compare Goldbach ($p + q = 2k$, finite pairs) with Polignac ($p - q = 2k$, infinitely many pairs)!

title: Additive Bases & Schnirelmann Density
hook: Can every number be built from adding at most $h$ primes? In 1930, Lev Schnirelmann shocked the world by proving the primes form a finite additive basis. Watch integer coverage explode from order 1 to order 3!

title: The 1742 Goldbach-Euler Letter
hook: Step back to June 7, 1742! Inspect the historic letter from Christian Goldbach to Leonhard Euler that sparked the most famous unsolved problem in arithmetic. Click the highlighted manuscript passages to analyze their mathematical significance.

title: Chen's Theorem: $N = p + P_2$ (1 + 2)
hook: In 1973, Chinese mathematician Chen Jingrun (陈景润) astonished the mathematical world with "1 + 2": every sufficiently large even number is the sum of a prime and an "almost prime" having at most 2 prime factors!

title: Schnirelmann's Constant: The 300,000 to 3 Plummet
hook: How many primes does it take to build ANY integer? In 1930, Lev Schnirelmann proved at most 300,000. Over 83 years, mathematicians drove this cosmic ceiling down to 3! Step through the timeline of discoveries.

title: Landau's Four Unsolved Prime Problems
hook: At the 1912 International Congress of Mathematicians in Cambridge, Edmund Landau highlighted four foundational prime conjectures that he declared "unattackable in the present state of science". Over a century later, all four remain open!

title: Gauss's $\text{Li}(x)$ & Prime Counting Function $\pi(x)$
hook: At age 15, Carl Friedrich Gauss noticed that primes thin out like $1/\ln x$. Discover how Gauss's logarithmic integral $\text{Li}(x)$ underpins both the Prime Number Theorem and the Hardy-Littlewood Goldbach formula!

title: The Music of the Primes: Riemann Zeta Zeros
hook: In 1859, Bernhard Riemann uncovered the secret symphony of prime numbers: each complex zero of $\zeta(s)$ is a musical harmonic! Summing these waves creates sharp acoustic interference peaks exactly at the prime numbers.

title: Terence Tao's 2012 Theorem: Odd Numbers as $\le 5$ Primes
hook: In 2012, Fields Medalist Terence Tao proved that every odd integer greater than 1 is the sum of at most FIVE prime numbers. Enter any odd number to decompose it into its minimal prime basis!

title: Uncle Petros & Goldbach's Conjecture
hook: Inspired by Apostolos Doxiadis's celebrated mathematical novel! Step into the quiet Athens study of Uncle Petros Papachristos. Solve his three tests of mathematical intuition and confront Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem.

title: Supercomputer Verifications: Up to $4 \times 10^{18}$
hook: From pencil-and-paper in 1938 to distributed supercomputing clusters in 2012, humanity has tested every single even number up to 4 Quintillion ($4 \times 10^{18}$) without encountering a single counter-example!

title: Hilbert's 8th Problem Explorer (Paris 1900)
hook: At the dawn of the 20th century in Paris, David Hilbert unveiled 23 problems that charted the future of mathematics. Problem #8 united the Riemann Hypothesis and Goldbach's Conjecture. Why has Goldbach outlasted Fermat and Poincaré?

title: Elliptic Curves over Finite Fields $E(\mathbb{F}_p)$
hook: Elliptic curves power modern cryptography and solved Fermat's Last Theorem! Decompose even number $N$ into a Goldbach pair $(p, q)$, and compare the elliptic curves $y^2 \equiv x^3 + ax + b$ defined over the finite fields $\mathbb{F}_p$ and $\mathbb{F}_q$.

title: Modular Forms & $q$-Series Expansion
hook: Inside the unit disk $|q| < 1$, the prime series $P(q) = \sum q^p$ transforms into a complex analytical field. Watch the major arc cusps ignite around the unit circle as $q$ approaches rational roots of unity $e^{2\pi i a/b}$!

title: Dirichlet Characters $\chi(n)$ & Orthogonality
hook: How did Dirichlet prove primes exist in all coprimes progressions? By inventing Dirichlet Characters—periodic complex wavelets whose orthogonality cancels out every unwanted residue, isolating Goldbach pairs with algebraic precision!

title: Primitive Roots & Cyclic Groups mod $p$
hook: Every prime modulus $p$ possesses a magical generator $g$: its powers $g^1, g^2, g^3, \dots, g^{p-1} \pmod p$ visit every single non-zero number in a perfect cyclic loop! Explore cyclic group structure in Goldbach primes.

title: Gauss's Golden Theorem: Quadratic Reciprocity
hook: Carl Friedrich Gauss was so proud of Quadratic Reciprocity that he published eight distinct proofs! Given any Goldbach prime pair $(p, q)$, test whether $p$ is a square mod $q$, and discover why their mutual solvability is linked by the golden law!

title: Continued Fractions of Goldbach Pairs
hook: Expand the prime ratio $p / q$ of any Goldbach pair into its unique Continued Fraction $[a_0; a_1, a_2, \dots]$. Watch Euclidean square-dissections and compute the optimal rational convergents!

title: Farey Sequences & Ford Circles for Goldbach Pairs
hook: Lester R. Ford discovered that fractions $p/q$ can be represented as tangent bubbles resting on the number line! For any Goldbach partition $p + q = N$, the fractions $p/N$ and $q/N$ produce twin Ford circles mirrored across the center $1/2$.

title: $p$-Adic Numbers & Hensel's Lemma
hook: What if two numbers are considered "close" when their difference is divisible by a high power of prime $p$? Step into Kurt Hensel's $p$-Adic Ultrametric Universe and explore tree branching modulo $p, p^2, p^3$!

title: The Möbius Function $\mu(n)$ & Prime Filtering
hook: August Ferdinand Möbius invented a function that takes only three values: $+1, -1, 0$. Yet this humble arithmetic function filters out all composite numbers and powers the modern sieves that attack Goldbach's conjecture!

title: Mersenne Primes $2^p - 1$ in Goldbach Pairs
hook: The largest known primes in human history are all Mersenne Primes $M_p = 2^p - 1$. What happens when a cosmic titan like $M_{31} = 2,147,483,647$ partners with a tiny prime like 3 to form a Goldbach pair?

title: Classroom Whiteboard & Scribe
hook: A dedicated classroom demonstration chalkboard! Enter any even number $N$, and watch the automated Smart Scribe execute and narrate each mathematical step of the Goldbach decomposition in real time.

title: Teacher's Custom Lesson & Challenge Builder
hook: Empowering educators! Configure customized Goldbach discovery worksheets tailored to your grade level (Elementary, Middle, or High School), preview the live assignment, and export printable student activity sheets.

title: The Ultimate Counter-Example Hunter
hook: Unleash the high-speed search engine! Scan millions of even integers in real time to hunt for any anomaly or zero-partition counter-example $g(N) = 0$. Can your browser discover a crack in Goldbach's armor?

title: CSV & JSON Dataset Laboratory
hook: A full scientific dataset generator for student research and science fair projects! Customize your number range, filter by modular properties, explore data tables, and export standard CSV or JSON files.

title: Prime Gaps $g_n = p_{n+1} - p_n$ & Goldbach Bridges
hook: How large can composite deserts grow between consecutive primes? Compare the Maximal Prime Gap $G(N)$ with the Least Goldbach Prime $p_{\min}(N)$ to see why Goldbach bridges easily cross prime chasms!

title: Primality Benchmark & Goldbach Arena
hook: How fast can computers find Goldbach pairs $p + q = 2N$? Pit Trial Division, Fermat Pseudoprimality, and Miller-Rabin Deterministic tests against each other in real-time execution!

title: Interactive Atlas of Number Theory
hook: Explore the constellation of mathematical ideas surrounding Goldbach's Conjecture! Discover how Sieve Theory, Circle Method, Riemann Zeta, and Elliptic Curves interweave across 300 years of history.

title: Student Research Journal & Conjecture Log
hook: Become a number theorist! Formulate your own mathematical hypotheses about primes and sums, run empirical verification tests, and maintain your personal research logbook.

title: Virtual Exhibition Hall of Primes & Goldbach
hook: Step into the mathematical gallery! Experience the breathtaking aesthetic beauty of prime spirals, Fourier circle arcs, the Goldbach comet rainbow, and 3D prime simplices.

title: Grand Unification Laboratory - The Goldbach Symphony
hook: The culmination of our 100-lab voyage! Witness how physical scales, modular clocks, asymptotic comets, and ternary partitions harmonize into a single unified mathematical truth for any even number $2N$.
